title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're working with an established, growing digital agency in the North East that is looking for an ambitious and hands-on Marketing Manager.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced digital marketer who is ready to take the next step in their agency career, combining hands-on digital marketing with client strategy, account ownership and team development.

You'll play a central role in driving performance across a portfolio of client accounts while supporting and mentoring a growing marketing team.

The role would suit a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist or existing Marketing Manager with strong technical expertise who wants greater ownership of strategy and the opportunity to develop their leadership and commercial skills.

You'll work closely with senior leadership and have a clear progression route towards taking greater ownership of the marketing department.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Support & Leadership
- Act as a day-to-day point of support for a team of marketing specialists, content executives and apprentices.
- Mentor team members, share technical knowledge and help maintain consistently high standards across client delivery.
- Support the coordination of project timelines, workloads and team capacity.
- Work closely with senior leadership to continue developing your management and leadership capabilities.

Client Strategy & Account Management
- Take ownership of key client relationships and act as a strategic point of contact.
- Translate performance data into clear insights and recommendations.
- Lead regular client review calls and meetings.
- Develop joined-up digital marketing strategies across SEO, paid media, content and social media.
- Support proposals, pitches and digital strategies for prospective clients.

Hands-on Digital Marketing
- Remain hands-on with campaign delivery and optimisation across your core area of expertise, whether that's SEO, PPC, Content or Social Media.
- Provide SEO, UX and strategic input into website rebuilds, migrations and landing page projects.
- Work collaboratively with design and development teams.
- Monitor and report on performance using tools including GA4, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.
- Identify opportunities to improve performance and drive further growth across client accounts.

Key Requirements:
- Digital marketing experience, ideally gained within a fast-paced agency environment managing multiple client accounts.
- Strong practical knowledge across digital marketing disciplines including SEO, PPC, Content and/or Social Media, with deeper expertise in at least one area.
- Experience using data and analytics to measure performance and campaign ROI.
- Knowledge of tools including GA4 and Looker Studio.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Confidence building and maintaining relationships with client stakeholders.
- A degree in Marketing, Business or a related subject, or equivalent practical industry experience.
- A genuine ambition to progress into a broader leadership position.

Desirable Experience
- Previous team management, mentoring or project management experience.
- Experience supporting website migrations, re-platforming or launches.
- Knowledge of WordPress, Shopify or similar CMS platforms.
- Experience creating custom Looker Studio dashboards.

For more information, apply now!

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We're working with a highly successful, fast-growing business within the beauty sector, with an established presence across both the UK and international markets.

They are looking for someone with previous experience working within the beauty or hair industry, alongside proven experience managing and developing a social media team. You'll understand the market, its audiences and the type of content that resonates within the sector, while being confident leading a team and driving the overall social strategy.

Operating across both consumer and professional audiences, the business has built a strong reputation for premium products, exceptional quality and ethical sourcing. With an ambitious growth strategy and an expanding team, this is an exciting opportunity to join the business at a key stage of its development.

This role can be remote, with occasional travel to their office in the North East.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to lead the organic social media strategy across two established hair and beauty brands.

This is a social-first, brand-led role with a particular focus on growing brand authority, engagement and community across both professional and consumer audiences.

You'll take ownership of the overall social strategy while managing and developing a team of two Social Media Executives responsible for day-to-day execution.

A key part of the role will be building and nurturing the brand's professional hairdresser and stylist community, creating engaging social-first content and developing meaningful relationships with industry professionals and brand advocates.

Key Responsibilities:

Social Media Strategy & Direction
- Define and own the organic social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and emerging platforms.
- Establish clear objectives, content pillars and platform strategies aligned with wider brand and growth goals.
- Oversee weekly and monthly content planning to ensure consistency, quality and strategic alignment.
- Collaborate with brand, digital and education teams to ensure social activity supports wider campaigns and business initiatives.

Content Leadership & Storytelling
- Lead the strategic direction of social content across in-house creation, stylists, educators and community-led storytelling.
- Brief and provide creative direction for social-first content shoots, campaigns and activations.
- Establish and maintain standards for visual identity, tone of voice and storytelling across organic social channels.
- Ensure content is created with repurposing in mind, supporting paid social, CRM and web activity where appropriate.
- Support the development of founder, educator and spokesperson content in line with wider brand positioning and thought leadership.

Leadership & Team Management
- Line manage and develop two Social Media Executives.
- Set clear expectations, priorities and objectives across the team.
- Provide ongoing coaching, guidance and feedback to support professional development and consistently high-quality output.
- Establish clear ownership across strategy, leadership and execution to create an efficient and effective social function.

Community, Performance & Reporting
- Develop the approach to community engagement and brand voice across social channels.
- Oversee sentiment monitoring and community insights, identifying advocates, creators and UGC opportunities.
- Own social and community reporting, tracking KPIs across brand growth, engagement and community participation.
- Use performance insights to continually refine content and social strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Report into the senior Brand & Marketing leadership team and work closely with departments across the business.
- Collaborate with senior stakeholders on social, content and storytelling initiatives.
- Act as a key internal expert for social media and community activity, providing strategic direction and leadership across the business.

Requirements:
- Proven experience within a Social Media, Community or Brand-focused role, ideally within hair, beauty, cosmetics, fashion or a similar consumer-led industry.
- Previous people-management experience, including coaching and developing direct reports.
- Demonstrable experience owning organic social strategy across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube.
- A track record of delivering social growth, engagement and measurable brand impact.
- A strong understanding of brand-led, social-first storytelling and the ability to translate brand positioning into engaging and culturally relevant content.
- Experience working with professional, trade or industry communities.
- Experience developing engaged communities, professional networks or brand advocacy programmes.
- The ability to brief, direct and oversee content creation including shoots, campaigns and social activations.

For more information, apply now!

title: Marketing & Communications Manager
company: Tynedale Hospice at Home - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job title: Marketing & Communications Manager

Location: Hexham, hybrid working will be considered.

Hours: Full-time, with some weekend and out of hours working

Reports to: Head of Income Generation

Salary £35,000 per annum

Tynedale Hospice at Home is a well-established charity of over 30 years. We're here to provide high quality care and support to the approximately 70,000 residents of West Northumberland, Tynedale, and Ponteland. We offer wraparound home-based care and support for adults with palliative needs or undergoing treatment for life-limiting conditions and people of all ages needing pre or post-bereavement support.

Join us as Marketing & Communications Manager at a defining moment for Tynedale Hospice at Home. We're at the start of a new 10-year strategy, with brand development at its heart, and this role will play a central part in shaping how we tell our story, grow our reach and make a lasting impact on the people and families we support. You'll lead the storytelling, campaigns and channels that raise our profile and drive vital supporter engagement, developing integrated marketing and communications plans that boost awareness, improve access to our care services, recruit and retain supporters, and amplify fundraising activity across digital, print and community touchpoints.

This is a hands-on, strategic role where your creativity and data-led approach will directly increase income and deepen community connections. As the lead communicator for a small Hospice at a pivotal point in its history, you'll have real scope to shape our brand, test new ideas, and see the measurable impact of your work on the people and families we support.

This role is perfect for you if:
- You love turning impact into clear, compelling stories that motivate action.
- You enjoy planning and delivering multi channel campaigns from brief to delivery.
- You're comfortable with both creative production and performance analysis.
- You like working closely with fundraising, programmes and senior staff in a small team.
- You want to see your work directly support local people and services.
- You'd relish the chance to help shape a brand and strategy that will define the Hospice for the next 10 years.

What you'll be doing:
- Playing a key role in our brand development work, helping translate our new 10-year strategy into a clear, compelling identity across everything we do.
- Developing and owning an integrated marketing & communications plan to support organisational goals across fundraising and Hospice services.
- Planning and delivering multi channel campaigns (digital, email, PR, print, events) that drive awareness, acquisition and retention.
- Creating and commissioning written, visual and video content that communicates impact and donor journeys.
- Managing website content, social channels, email marketing and paid digital activity; monitoring performance and optimising campaigns.
- Collaborating with Fundraising to design supporter communications, stewardship materials and campaign briefs.
- Managing external suppliers, volunteers and budgets; ensuring brand consistency and compliance.

What we're looking for:
- 3+ years' experience in marketing/communications, ideally with charity or fundraising experience.
- Strong copywriting, content production and campaign management skills.
- Practical experience with CMS, email platforms, social media and analytics tools.
- Creative, organised and data focused with the ability to prioritise and deliver to deadlines.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach.

Why join us?
- Join us at a pivotal moment for the Hospice - help shape the brand, voice and profile that will carry our new 10-year strategy forward.
- Play a central role in shaping our public profile and increasing vital income for, and awareness of, local Hospice care.
- A visible, strategic position with freedom to innovate, test new approaches and leave a lasting mark on how we're known.
- Opportunities for professional development and varied hands on experience.
- Flexible working and meaningful, direct impact on patients and families.

Closing date: 9am 12 October

Interviews: w/c 19 October

title: Content & Campaign Executive
description:
The Business:
This is a unique opportunity to join a private equity-backed business at a pivotal point in its journey.

With significant investment, a refreshed leadership team, and multiple transformation programmes underway, the organisation is entering its next phase of growth. They are now looking to shape the marketing team and bring on board progressive, tech-savvy content marketing candidates.

The Role:
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established brand where you'll have the chance to create content across multiple channels and play a key role in delivering integrated marketing campaigns.

You'll be responsible for producing content for websites, email campaigns, social media, podcasts, video and other digital channels, while collaborating with designers, digital specialists and wider stakeholders to bring campaigns to life.

For the role you will need;
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills
- Experience across digital marketing channels
- The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
- A creative mindset coupled with excellent attention to detail
- Experience contributing to integrated marketing campaigns
The Person:
You will need to demonstrate a diverse marketing background, sector mix would be ideal and ability to prove you have been working in a progressive environment.

You will need to show experience working with AI, emerging technology, an innovative mindset and a keen interest to continue learning in this space.

The client is looking for confidence in speaking with senior stakeholders and the appetite to work within a large marketing team and fast-paced environment.

You will need to be able to showcase digital channel experience, brand experience and campaign building and execution experience.

title: Digital Growth Lead
description:
The Business:
Nigel Wright are delighted to be supporting a market-leading consumer brand in the search for a Digital Growth Lead.

The Role:
Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you'll own digital performance across paid, owned and organic channels, taking responsibility for driving customer acquisition, website performance, conversion and customer lifetime value. You'll work closely with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Revenue, E-commerce, Finance and Operations to ensure digital investment is delivering commercial results.

Own and deliver the digital growth strategy across paid, owned and organic channels.
Drive customer acquisition, online revenue growth and marketing ROI.
Lead performance across Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, Affiliates and emerging channels.
Manage and challenge external agencies to maximise performance and continuously improve results.
Take ownership of digital marketing budgets, spend efficiency, ROAS and acquisition costs.
Develop and optimise the end-to-end customer journey from acquisition through to conversion and retention.
Use GA4, customer data and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve decision making.
Build meaningful reporting dashboards and performance frameworks.
Identify and test new channels, AI tools, technologies and growth opportunities.
Stay ahead of developments in AI, search, SEO, GEO and changing consumer behaviour.

You will have one direct report and will need to demonstrate good leadership qualities.
The Person:
You will need to demonstrate strong experience in performance marketing and digital growth, strong stakeholder management and communication skills alongside a commercially driven mindset with a passion for testing, optimisation and continuous improvement.

You will be a compassionate and inspiring leader and enjoy supporting a growing team and a fast-paced business.

This is a hybrid role, with some travel.

title: Digital Specialist
description:
The Business:
Nigel Wright are delighted to be supporting a leading organisation as they continue to invest in their digital marketing function with the appointment of a Digital Marketing Specialist.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business that is building more digital capability in-house and placing a strong focus on data-led decision making, customer acquisition, conversion optimisation and emerging AI-driven search opportunities.

The Role:
Reporting into the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in planning, executing and optimising digital acquisition campaigns across a range of channels.

You'll work closely with marketing, digital experience, analytics and external agency partners to improve campaign performance, strengthen customer journeys and increase conversion across key audiences.

This role offers a broad remit, making it ideal for someone looking to develop expertise across performance marketing, SEO, analytics, CRO and AI search optimisation.
The Person:
- Experience in a digital marketing, campaign marketing or performance marketing role
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Google Analytics
- Strong understanding of SEO and content optimisation principles
- Experience supporting paid social campaigns
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- The ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into action
- Strong stakeholder management and organisational skills

You will be able to work dynamically, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, it will give you the opportunity to work across a large-scale marketing function and develop your skills at pace!

title: Marketing Planner
description:
The opportunity
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-profile marketing function at a time of significant growth and transformation. You'll play a central role in shaping how marketing activity is planned, prioritised and delivered, working across multiple teams, channels and audiences.

Sitting at the heart of the marketing operation, you'll help ensure the right projects are being delivered at the right time, bringing structure, coordination and commercial focus to an ambitious marketing agenda.

The role
As Marketing Planner, you'll act as the bridge between the wider business and marketing specialists, translating commercial priorities into clear, actionable marketing plans.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across a variety of functions to coordinate activity, manage priorities and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively. This is a highly visible role that combines planning, project management, stakeholder engagement and performance tracking.

Key areas of focus
- Develop and maintain integrated marketing plans that support business objectives.
- Translate commercial priorities into clear marketing briefs and delivery plans.
- Coordinate activity across multiple marketing disciplines and specialist teams.
- Manage planning schedules, workflows and key project milestones.
- Support campaign planning, prioritisation and resource allocation.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.
- Monitor delivery against plans and provide regular progress updates.
- Identify risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Support performance reporting and campaign review processes.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of planning frameworks and ways of working.

About you
You'll be a highly organised marketing professional who thrives on bringing people, projects and priorities together. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, you'll have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to keep multiple workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

We're looking for someone who combines commercial awareness with strong planning discipline, enjoys working collaboratively and can confidently influence across different teams and levels of the business.

You may have experience in marketing planning, campaign management, marketing operations, project management or a similar coordination-focused role where you've been responsible for driving activity from concept through to delivery.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Reed in Teesside are working with an established business based in Middlesbrough who are looking to appoint a full time, permanent Digital Marketing Executive to join their Sales & Marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone that would like to continue and develop their marketing skills and gain further exposure to different areas of marketing.

Benefits:
- 25 days A/L + BH
- Pension
- Free parking
- Social events
- Annual bonus scheme (company discretion)
- Hours: Monday to Friday - 08:30 - 17:15

Reporting into the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will work as part of a small team where you will be responsible for developing and delivering data-driven marketing campaigns across multiple channels including social media platforms, email, video, SEO and PR. You will be liaising with a third-party agency to support the delivery of company-agreed SEO and PPC strategies.

Duties:
- Lead market research for the brand: analyse trends, competitor activity, and target audience insights
- Create engaging content for social media channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube)
- Manage social media presence: schedule posts, review analytics, and contribute new content ideas
- Identify emerging trends and implement strategies to grow the customer base through lead generation (e.g., LinkedIn Ads, PPC)
- Develop marketing materials, including brochures, infographics, and other collateral
- Create and manage email marketing strategies
- Produce short- and long-form video content
- Plan and execute SEO-focused content strategies, including blogs and other formats
- Apply strong working knowledge of SEO principles
- Develop proficiency in key marketing tools using CRM and Canva
- Use strong organisational skills to plan, create, and deliver key marketing activities
- Create PR-friendly content to support SEO outreach strategies
- Liaise with third-party providers such as SEO/PPC agencies and PR publications
- Act as a positive role model within the business and strive to improve customer satisfaction
- Collaborate with colleagues and managers to deliver exceptional customer service
- Complete industry training and maintain relevant technical knowledge

The person -

This is a B2 B marketing role that relies heavily on creativity, good organisation skills, a keen eye for detail, and an aptitude to promote products and services that generate marketing leads for the Sales team.

If you are:
- Able to work on your own autonomy and part of a small team
- Have previous experience using a CRM system to drive automated marketing campaigns
- Have experience using various Adobe tools and Canva
- Savvy in areas such as generative content through AI
- Have experience creating video content (not essential but desirable)
- Want to progress and learn and further develop your skills and experience
- Can manage a heavy workload and work to tight deadlines
- Follow target driven metrics and follow and execute a marketing plan

Then I want to hear from you Interviews to be held ASAP!
